captions.text: Here the page belongs to “account-check.example”. The “samplebank” in front is only a subdomain that anyone can create.

captions.text: A padlock symbol does not protect you from fraud either. It only shows that the connection is encrypted, not who owns the page.
A short pause to think: What does the padlock symbol in the address bar tell you?
